stories.title: Disney 拟接收 Character.AI 大部分员工，属竞标前的“马前卒”收购要约
stories.sourceTitle: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
stories.summary: 提交文件显示，被提供 Disney 岗位的 Character.AI 员工中“绝大多数”已接受；但该交易属于 stalking horse bid（马前卒报价），其他公司仍可能出更高价截胡。
stories.analysis: 以雇佣团队而非收购公司的方式拿下 AI 能力，正成为大厂规避并购审查的常用路径，但竞标机制意味着结果仍可能生变。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.

stories.title: 费城女子因挡住 Uber 送货机器人被捕，称抗议其取代人类配送工作
stories.sourceTitle: A woman was arrested in Philly for blocking a delivery robot
stories.summary: Carolyn Marvin 因阻挡一台 Uber 送货机器人通行、拒绝让路而被捕并被控扰乱治安，她向 ABC13 表示自己是在抗议机器人抢走人类配送员的工作。
stories.analysis: 机器人上街后的第一波冲突不是技术故障，而是劳资与公共空间规则，城市监管会先于产品成熟到来。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Carolyn Marvin was arrested and charged with disorderly conduct after blocking the path of an Uber delivery robot and refusing to get out of the way. Marvin told Philadelphia's ABC13 "I know they're taking the jobs of human delivery workers and so, I have been

stories.title: Anthropic 承诺把 5% 股份投入“公益基金”
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
stories.summary: Anthropic 表示将把公司 5% 的股份捐入一个公益基金。此举在 AI 公司估值高企、社会对收益分配质疑升温的背景下具有示范意味。
stories.analysis: 用股权而非利润做公益承诺，是把长期治理结构提前锁死，但 5% 的实际影响力仍取决于投票权与退出机制。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic said that it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund.

stories.title: 遭遇反弹后，Meta 删除可能允许其抓取新闻网站内容的条款
stories.sourceTitle: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
stories.summary: 在舆论压力下，Meta 再次修改商业条款，删去暗示其可抓取包括新闻网站在内的站点内容用于训练 AI 的表述。
stories.analysis: 条款措辞的进与退说明“默认授权抓取”在法律和公关上都撑不住，但删掉一句话不等于放弃数据诉求。
stories.sourceExcerpt: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no longer appears on the commercial terms page: … Meta may use an

stories.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X 上手一周：Arm 笔记本“超级芯片”实测体验
stories.sourceTitle: A week with RTX Spark: everything we’ve learned using Nvidia’s new laptops
stories.summary: The Verge 用一周时间测试了多款搭载 NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X 的笔记本，这颗面向笔记本和小型台式机的 Arm 架构 SoC 主打高性能。
stories.analysis: NVIDIA 从 GPU 供应商向整机平台延伸，真正的考验是 Windows on Arm 的软件生态能否跟上。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X processor is finally here, and we've been collectively testing a small fortune's worth of powerful laptops sporting this new "superchip." RTX Spark is designed to be a high-performing Arm-based SoC for laptops and small desktop computers

stories.title: Meta 新条款被指可免费抓取新闻网站内容训练 AI，10 月 30 日生效
stories.sourceTitle: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free
stories.summary: 据 Nieman Lab 报道，Meta 将于 10 月 30 日生效的新条款，似乎允许其抓取和使用自家平台企业（含网络出版商）所“关联”的网站内容。
stories.analysis: 把授权藏在平台服务条款里，等于让内容方在“用不用 Facebook”与“被不被爬”之间二选一。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta's new terms appear to give it permission to crawl and scrape websites "associated" with the businesses that use its platforms - including online publishers, according to a report from Nieman Lab. The new terms, which go into effect on October 30th, say Me

stories.title: 反科技情绪上银幕：2026 年一批批判硅谷的电影集中上映
stories.sourceTitle: The tech backlash is now in theaters
stories.summary: 2026 年多部影片以更批判的视角审视硅谷如何重塑现实，包括 Aaron Sorkin 的《The Social Reckoning》，片中把 Mark Zuckerberg 塑造成“机器人式”人物。
stories.analysis: 大众叙事从“科技英雄”转向“科技问责”，这会反过来影响 AI 公司的公众沟通与监管环境。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Though movies about disruptive tech founders are nothing new, 2026 has been unusually stacked with features that take a much more critical look at how Silicon Valley is reshaping our reality. Aaron Sorkin's The Social Reckoning frames Mark Zuckerberg as a robo

stories.title: Trump 在 Truth Social 发布疑似 AI 修改的白宫修缮对比照
stories.sourceTitle: Trump posts AI-edited photo to brag about White House restoration work
stories.summary: Trump 发布多张白宫翻新照片，其中一张新旧立柱对比图被发现有多处不一致，疑似经 AI 修改，用于宣传修缮成果。
stories.analysis: 当政治宣传开始默认使用生成图，图像真实性的公共成本会比任何一次模型翻车都更持久。
stories.sourceExcerpt: President Donald Trump posted a series of photos on Truth Social showing off renovations to the White House - but one of them appears to be modified with AI. The picture, which compares an old White House column to a "restored" one, has several discrepancies a

stories.title: 巴西 Itaú 银行用 ia.i 对话界面和 IARA 治理平台，把生成式 AI 铺向全部客户
stories.sourceTitle: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
stories.summary: Itaú 通过对话式界面 ia.i 与治理平台 IARA，将“AI First”战略同时落到客户与员工侧，而银行业是巴西监管最严的行业之一。
stories.analysis: 强监管行业的规模化落地，决定成败的往往是治理平台而不是底层模型。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

stories.title: Benefit Street Partners 用 Codex 做代码审查，加快贷款估值与信贷协议问答
stories.sourceTitle: Benefit Street Partners answers questions faster with Codex
stories.summary: Anant Kumar 借助 Codex 构建贷款估值对比和信贷协议分析工具，并用于代码审查与更快的问题跟进。
stories.analysis: 金融场景里 Codex 的价值更多体现在分析工具的“造工具”速度，而非直接给出结论。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anant Kumar builds tools to compare loan valuations and analyze credit agreements, using Codex for code review and faster follow-ups.

stories.title: OpenAI 上线巴西葡萄牙语版 AI for Educators，用 Study Mode 引导提问式学习
stories.sourceTitle: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
stories.summary: 借教师节，OpenAI 推出巴西葡萄牙语的 AI for Educators 资源，演示 Study Mode 如何帮助教师支持分步骤、主动式学习。
stories.analysis: 教育是 AI 最容易被质疑“代劳”的领域，强调过程而非答案，是目前最稳妥的产品定位。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Celebrate Teachers’ Day with AI for Educators in Brazilian Portuguese and see how Study Mode can help teachers support active, step-by-step learning.

stories.title: Sullivan & Cromwell 与 OpenAI 合作开发 Agreement Analyzer 审查合同草案
stories.sourceTitle: Sullivan & Cromwell brings legal expertise into agreement review
stories.summary: 律所 Sullivan & Cromwell 与 OpenAI 合作推出 Agreement Analyzer，用 AI 识别合同草案中的问题条款。
stories.analysis: 顶级律所亲自参与建模，说明法律 AI 的竞争点正从通用能力转向流程与专业知识的深度嵌入。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In collaboration with OpenAI, Sullivan & Cromwell developed Agreement Analyzer, an AI tool for identifying issues in a draft agreement.

stories.title: SentinelOne 借 OpenAI Daybreak 把恶意软件分析从数周缩短到数小时
stories.sourceTitle: SentinelOne cuts malware analysis from weeks to hours
stories.summary: SentinelOne 使用 OpenAI Daybreak 将原本数周的恶意软件分析压缩到数小时，从而腾出产能调查更多威胁。
stories.analysis: 安全运营是 AI 回报最可量化的场景之一，时间压缩直接换算成可处理的威胁数量。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With OpenAI Daybreak, SentinelOne cuts weeks of malware analysis to hours, creating capacity to investigate more threats.

stories.title: Higgsfield 用 GPT-6 Astra 把 AI 视频从 1 分钟拉长到 10 分钟以上
stories.sourceTitle: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10
stories.summary: Higgsfield 借助 GPT-6 Astra 生成更长视频、用 GPT-Image-2.5 提升画面精度，并通过 GPT-Live 探索语音驱动的影片制作。
stories.analysis: 视频生成的门槛正从“画面好不好看”转向“能不能讲完一个十分钟的故事”。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Higgsfield brings creators longer videos with GPT-6 Astra, precise visuals with GPT-Image-2.5, and a path to voice filmmaking with GPT-Live.

stories.title: Sophos 用 OpenAI Daybreak 将威胁调查时间削减 96%
stories.sourceTitle: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
stories.summary: Sophos 借助 Daybreak 把网络威胁调查时间缩短 96%，并自动化处理 52% 的 MDR 案件，同时保留人工监督。
stories.analysis: 96% 与 52% 这两个数字，为“AI 替代多少安全人力”提供了少见的可核查样本。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.

stories.title: Pollo AI 组合 GPT-5.6、GPT-6 Astra 与 GPT-Image-2.5 批量生产广告素材
stories.sourceTitle: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
stories.summary: Pollo AI 用 GPT-5.6、GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-Image-2.5，帮创作者把创意想法转成精细图像与电影感视频广告。
stories.analysis: 广告素材生产正变成多模型流水线，单一模型的差异化会被编排能力稀释。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.

stories.title: LegalOn 把 Codex 日均成本降 65%，按任务分配 Astra、Sol、Luna
stories.sourceTitle: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
stories.summary: LegalOn 在保持开发速度的前提下，将预估的 Codex 日均成本削减 65%，做法是把 Astra、Sol、Luna 等模型按任务匹配并做预算管理。
stories.analysis: 模型路由与预算管理正在成为工程团队的新基本功，成本优化空间比换供应商更大。
stories.sourceExcerpt: LegalOn cut estimated daily Codex costs by 65% while maintaining development speed. It matched Astra, Sol, and Luna to tasks and managed budgets strategically.

stories.title: OpenAI 阻断两起用“假记者”和智库作伪装的 AI 影响行动
stories.sourceTitle: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
stories.summary: OpenAI 表示已阻断两起借助 AI 运作的影响行动，这些行动使用假前台记者和一家智库来扩散地缘政治叙事。
stories.analysis: 影响力行动的伪装成本被 AI 压到极低，平台侧的披露与阻断将越来越像常态化的情报工作。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI disrupted two AI-enabled influence operations that used false-front journalists and a think tank to spread geopolitical messaging.

stories.title: ChatGPT for Teens 上线 College Planner，并组建青少年 AI 顾问委员会
stories.sourceTitle: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
stories.summary: OpenAI 为青少年版 ChatGPT 增加 College Planner 帮助管理大学申请，同时推出闪卡、测验功能并设立青少年 AI 顾问委员会。
stories.analysis: 在监管压力下，青少年产品线的策略是“加工具、加治理、加参与感”三件套。
stories.sourceExcerpt: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

stories.title: OpenAI 公开内部前沿模型在数学开放问题上的新结果与 Lean 证明
stories.sourceTitle: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
stories.summary: OpenAI 发布内部前沿模型在若干数学开放问题上的新结果，并在 GitHub 上公开 Lean 形式化证明与研究细节。
stories.analysis: 选择 Lean 形式化并开源细节，是把“模型能做数学”从宣传语变成可验证主张的关键一步。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

stories.title: OpenAI 与 Ironclad 合作训练 AI agent 处理复杂合同工作流
stories.sourceTitle: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
stories.summary: 双方在复杂合同流程上训练和评测 AI agent，以推进 computer use 在专业工作场景中的可用性。
stories.analysis: 合同流程步骤多、状态杂，是检验 agent 长链路操作能力的好试金石。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

stories.title: Atlassian 与 OpenAI 扩大合作，把企业知识接入前沿模型
stories.sourceTitle: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
stories.summary: 双方扩大合作，将前沿模型与 Atlassian 承载的企业知识打通，帮助团队完成规划、构建与交付工作。
stories.analysis: 协作工具是知识的入口，谁掌握入口，谁就决定企业 AI 拿到的上下文质量。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

stories.title: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 推出新视觉广告格式，扩展归因与品牌适配工具
stories.sourceTitle: Building advertising for the way people use AI
stories.summary: OpenAI 为广告主在 ChatGPT 中引入新的视觉广告形式，并扩充效果衡量、归因合作与品牌适配能力。
stories.analysis: 广告业务正式成形，意味着 ChatGPT 的商业模式开始从订阅向“注意力变现”分流。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

stories.title: Chatham Financial 用 Codex 和 GPT-5.6 把交易验证从 30 分钟压到 4 分钟内
stories.sourceTitle: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
stories.summary: Chatham Financial 借助 Codex 与 GPT-5.6 自建工具并重设工作流，使交易验证时间从 30 分钟缩短到 4 分钟以内。
stories.analysis: 金融中后台的收益来自流程重构，模型只是其中一环，这一点在案例里体现得很清楚。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign workflows, cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under 4.

stories.title: OpenAI 撰文：先进 AI 的价值可能主要在突破背后的“日常执行工作”
stories.sourceTitle: The eternal complement
stories.summary: 文章提出，先进 AI 对突破性想法背后的常规工作影响最大，并讨论执行环节将如何塑造下一轮经济与进步速度。
stories.analysis: 这是对“AI 只做低价值工作”叙事的反转，执行效率本身可能就是创新的主要瓶颈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Advanced AI may matter most for the routine work behind breakthrough ideas. Explore why execution could shape the next economy and the pace of progress.

stories.title: Meta 联手苹果推出全美最强开源模型，编码基测输给智谱、Kimi
stories.sourceTitle: Meta 联手苹果推出全美最强开源模型，编码基测输给智谱、Kimi
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文 报道关注「Meta 联手苹果推出全美最强开源模型，编码基测输给智谱、Kimi」。这条适合用来观察中国 AI 产品和企业应用落地，建议结合原文判断它对行业主线的实际影响。
stories.analysis: 这条来自中国 AI 生态，适合用来补足国内模型、产品、算力、政策和资本动向的观察。重点看它是否会改变国内 AI 应用落地和企业采用节奏。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: 网易“叭哥说”投 10 万元征集产品建议，不设专业和学历门槛
stories.sourceTitle: 说真话就能拿10万？网易叭哥说重金求“真需求”，不卡专业学历
stories.summary: 网易首个 AI 原生语音 Agent「网易叭哥说」上线“用户荣誉联创计划”，投入 10 万元面向普通用户征集产品建议。
stories.analysis: 用现金换真实需求，比内部猜测更能暴露语音 Agent 在日常场景中的短板。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 网易首个AI原生语音Agent「网易叭哥说」上线 “用户荣誉联创计划”，投入 10 万元征集产品建议

stories.title: Qwen 发布 Qwen3Guard：面向 token 流的实时安全护栏模型
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen3Guard 是 Qwen 系列首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 微调做安全分类，可对生成内容做实时审核，并已发布技术报告与开源权重。
stories.analysis: 把审核做成流式护栏模型，意味着安全从“事后过滤”变成生成过程中的实时约束。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tech Report GitHub Hugging Face ModelScope DISCORD Introduction We are excited to introduce Qwen3Guard, the first safety guardrail model in the Qwen family. Built upon the powerful Qwen3 foundation models and fine-tuned specifically for safety classificatoin,
